sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: HyperFrames is HeyGen's open-source framework and app for making videos from HTML. You or your AI agent write a page with timed clips, text and animations, and it renders a frame-accurate MP4.
sixtySeconds.problem: Editing video usually needs specialised software, and agents can't easily drive it. HyperFrames treats a video as an HTML file with timing attributes, so agents and developers can create and change videos like code.
whoFor: Developers who want to generate videos with code
Claude Code, Codex and Cursor users making videos with agents
Creators making explainers, product demos and social clips
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it if you want videos you can build and edit as HTML, with no build step. The Studio app has a free plan and a paid Pro plan for built-in AI models.
requirements: A coding agent, if you want agent-made videos

overview: A HyperFrames video is an HTML file. Clips, titles and audio get data attributes for start time, duration and track, and you can animate with GSAP, CSS, Lottie, Three.js, Anime.js or WAAPI. The renderer seeks each frame in headless Chrome and encodes it with FFmpeg, so output is deterministic.

There are three ways to use it: the HyperFrames Studio desktop app with no code, your coding agent with HyperFrames skills, or chat apps like Claude, ChatGPT and Grok (beta). Skills cover things like style sampling, remaking an existing video, slideshows and porting Remotion projects.

The CLI creates, previews and renders projects, and a catalog adds blocks like transitions, overlays, charts and maps. You can render locally, in Docker, in the cloud or on your own AWS Lambda. The framework is Apache-2.0; the Studio app has a free plan and a $25 per month Pro plan.

install.verificationNote: Commands come from HyperFrames's README. AIRepoHub hasn't run them yet.

steps.title: Install the skills
steps.body: Pick Core Skills in the picker.

steps.title: Or install without the picker (scripts, CI)
Add the marketplace and install
steps.code:
claude plugin marketplace add heygen-com/hyperframes
claude plugin install hyperframes@hyperframes

steps.title: Create, preview and render
steps.code:
npx hyperframes init my-video
cd my-video
npx hyperframes preview      # live preview in the browser
npx hyperframes render       # render to MP4
